abstract_title: Treating Glioblastoma via Induction of Retro-Cycloaddition of Neural Microtubules' C-Terminals by Specific Engineered & Mono-clonal Anti-Bodies and Holographic Cognitive Bio-chemical Mapping to retard
abstract: We recently attended a 4 day Brain Tumor conference at Cold Spring Harbor Lab, and in a stunning fashion, the first speaker, Dr. Patrick Wen, of Dana Farber Cancer Institute, appealed to the audience via an old Native American saying to make sure they are "not riding a dead horse, or that they have not become a dead horse."
